name: Taming the Beast
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
The variance of nature is something that can be relied upon, adventurer. It is predictable in the way that it never remains the same; it is always changing.

The tasks I give to you will help you to see and appreciate the vast differences of the creatures you may choose as your companion.

Take this taming rod and use it to tame a nightsaber stalker, found to the south. Practice your skills as a hunter. Then you will begin to understand the similarities and differences of nature.
narrative.objectives: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Nightsaber Stalker. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Dazalar in Dolanaar.
narrative.offerRewardText: I see your commitment and that you have understood what I have taught you, adventurer.
narrative.requestItemsText: Understanding the balance between nature and oneself is a way of life for every friend.
